name: Trödelmarkt am GLOBUS Köln-Marsdorf
facts: on the third Sunday of the month
a balanced mix of second-hand and new goods
a market location for over 20 years
near the Köln-West motorway junction; parking at ROLLER and Media Markt Marsdorf
notes: Three dates in the window, all third Sundays (18 Oct, 15 Nov, 20 Dec); nothing for January 2027 yet (the rhythm would give 17 Jan, not added). 'Eintritt frei' is from the site-wide Melan header, hence fee 0. Coordinates from Nominatim for Max-Planck-Straße 9.

description.de: Am dritten Sonntag im Monat von 11 bis 18 Uhr beim GLOBUS in Marsdorf, nahe dem Autobahnkreuz Köln-West. Trödel und Neuware halten sich die Waage, und an zahlreichen Ständen gibt es Essen und Trinken. Der Standort besteht seit über 20 Jahren; der Eintritt ist frei.
description.en: On the third Sunday of the month from 11 to 6 at the GLOBUS in Marsdorf, near the Köln-West motorway junction. An even mix of second-hand and new goods, with plenty of food stalls. The market has been held here for over 20 years, and entry is free.
